78273.subject: Uber’s Co-Founder Just Raised $1.7B for AI-Powered Robots
78273.body:
After eight years in stealth, qualified purchasers can gain exposure to Atoms

New Launch | Series Atoms-QP-1 (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/MWfT8rRDCrjW6nK-HY3DpZ-jW9ccHTJ5TlcYWN8Qx57W3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3nWW2wxcYZ4KDZTKW8qFsl91wpDQWW4S3drg4J7GqvW44TRx48MYb5lN45WvWPG3-FvN4hj-lHlpVVfW44FktT8jyKtMW2t_qgQ3KlmCMW8D6zg67RzwWFN2ZnQ5x4pwFHW92PYd78fzlyLW6H2rMT3XjQMPVsqmGN4C0qyjW4P7WXZ3Yz5dFW2BBNc88sy_WNW8jNZ-S2tW1BQW23Ft2B54hpxQW8FKmTw5W-DhYW21dRYB560LzpW40km4C1FG7bWW2YZBjX91FMFCW6YdRrl7dX0cbW8jSjp57fWbYYW59MSRc5-_fLNW92ywnW4sw_8LW9cbkzL6VvNCsW6QdVBf1Km-FRW1mQHT43yhPvRf1fx0_204 )

Hi Oleg,

Software spent two decades getting very good at moving information. The physical economy underneath it — the meals that get assembled, the rock that comes out of a pit — has barely changed.

That gap is the part of the AI buildout nobody has automated.

Atoms (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/MWfT8rRDCrjW6nK-HY3DpZ-jW9ccHTJ5TlcYWN8Qx57W3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3nWW2wxcYZ4KDZTKW8qFsl91wpDQWW4S3drg4J7GqvW44TRx48MYb5lN45WvWPG3-FvN4hj-lHlpVVfW44FktT8jyKtMW2t_qgQ3KlmCMW8D6zg67RzwWFN2ZnQ5x4pwFHW92PYd78fzlyLW6H2rMT3XjQMPVsqmGN4C0qyjW4P7WXZ3Yz5dFW2BBNc88sy_WNW8jNZ-S2tW1BQW23Ft2B54hpxQW8FKmTw5W-DhYW21dRYB560LzpW40km4C1FG7bWW2YZBjX91FMFCW6YdRrl7dX0cbW8jSjp57fWbYYW59MSRc5-_fLNW92ywnW4sw_8LW9cbkzL6VvNCsW6QdVBf1Km-FRW1mQHT43yhPvRf1fx0_204 ) is Travis Kalanick’s answer to it.

After eight years largely in stealth, the Uber co-founder’s robotics holding company emerged in July with a $1.7 billion round joined by with Uber, Bain Capital, and Fifth Wall.¹

The round was led by Andreessen Horowitz, and Ben Horowitz himself took a board seat.²

The machines already work:

- 2 million tons hauled: At a Heidelberg Materials quarry in Lake Bridgeport, Texas, Atoms’ autonomous haulage system moved over two million tons in a mixed fleet in under eight months.³
- 100+ trucks, a dozen+ sites: It runs across 100+ trucks at over a dozen Heidelberg operations worldwide, and powers Komatsu Smart Quarry Autonomous.³
- An idled copper mine, restarting: In April 2026, Mariana Minerals tapped Atoms’ Pronto unit to automate haulage at Copper One in Utah, wired into Mariana’s MineOS platform.⁴
- Five banks on the debt side: Bank of America, Goldman Sachs, Wells Fargo, JPMorgan, and Barclays were named as debt partners alongside the equity.⁵

There’s no guarantee that revenue, funding, or valuation will continue to grow for Atoms, or that the company will be profitable. See the risk disclosures on the offering page.

Qualified purchasers like you can now invest in Series Atoms-QP-1 (https://dxszHp04.na2.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/DR+113/dxszHp04/MWfT8rRDCrjW6nK-HY3DpZ-jW9ccHTJ5TlcYWN8Qx57W3pyd0W8wLKSR6lZ3nWW2wxcYZ4KDZTKW8qFsl91wpDQWW4S3drg4J7GqvW44TRx48MYb5lN45WvWPG3-FvN4hj-lHlpVVfW44FktT8jyKtMW2t_qgQ3KlmCMW8D6zg67RzwWFN2ZnQ5x4pwFHW92PYd78fzlyLW6H2rMT3XjQMPVsqmGN4C0qyjW4P7WXZ3Yz5dFW2BBNc88sy_WNW8jNZ-S2tW1BQW23Ft2B54hpxQW8FKmTw5W-DhYW21dRYB560LzpW4

78270.subject: 🟪 Load-bearing
78270.body:
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/7b2de0b8-c3e4-4d9f-bebd-a4df904b8501/BD-Banner-Sponsor_Template_-_Avalanche.png?t=1787346890)
Follow image link: (https://www.avalanchesummit.com/registration/)
Caption: 

----------



----------# 🛶 Moats & Boats

[The data layer of physical AI and robotics](https://substack.com/inbox/post/211749011?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store-no-desktop&inbox=true&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app&triedRedirect=true)

Shoal Research argues that training data may be the most valuable bottleneck in robotics because demonstrations must be physically performed and cannot simply be scraped from the internet. 

The report highlights Eastworlds, Virtuals Protocol’s robotics division, which uses teleoperated robots in real commercial settings to generate training data, record corrections and eventually train more autonomous models. 

It argues that owning the robot fleet, operators, paid deployments and data pipeline creates a stronger moat than selling raw recordings alone. However, falling data prices, simulation, in-house collection by robot makers and the risks of coordinating contributors through token incentives remain key challenges.

Caption: 

[The anatomy of a stablecoin card swipe](https://x.com/raincards/status/2087888130254729373?s=20)

The article explains how stablecoin cards preserve the existing card experience while replacing the slowest part of the system: settlement. 

Traditional issuers must pre-fund bank accounts, wait through banking hours and maintain separate pools of capital across currencies and jurisdictions. Stablecoin settlement instead allows them to pay networks such as Visa and Mastercard daily from a single global balance. 

Rain argues this frees idle capital, reduces reliance on correspondent banks and makes global card programs viable for smaller neobanks, marketplaces and fintechs. Merchants still receive local currency and users retain familiar rewards, making stablecoins an invisible infrastructure upgrade rather than a new payment experience.
